text:
aria: Opening a small docs PR that consolidates retention TTL examples and adds a concise 'how exports interact with retention' playbook. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/998

ben: Linking it now. Quick ask: can we include one concrete migration note for customers using the legacy export flow (/v1/export) vs the new redwoodctl? A tiny example helps reduce support churn.

aria: Yep, plan to add a brief section titled 'Export migration summary' with a before/after command and the minimal JSONL example.

charles: From security: please avoid phrasing that implies exported files are automatically redacted. We need a sentence: "Exports reflect the data at export time; customers are responsible for post-export handling and redaction."

aria: Got it, will add that and a pointer to the PII handling guide.

emma: For the SDK snippet, we should show both the Python and cURL examples. Proposed python snippet: 

```python
# snapshot export (v2 SDK)
from redwood import Client
cli = Client()
cli.exports.create_evidence(tenant_id="t_77", since="2024-09-01", output_path="./t77-evidence.jsonl")
```

And a cURL fallback for quick ops.

ben: Also include a short line about naming conventions for export files (timestamp + tenant id). We had a support ticket where a customer overwrote previous exports.

aria: Adding recommendation: use UTC ISO prefix: YYYYMMDDTHHMMSS_tenant.jsonl.

ci-bot: docs-ci: linkcheck found one broken reference in onboarding/getting-started.md -> /guides/old-export. Please fix before merging.

aria: Thanks CI. Replaced the stale link with /cli/exports and rebased.

charles: Legal: small wording tweak to the retention section 1 1 avoid the word "permanent". Suggest: "retention_locked: indicates records exempt from TTL deletion absent a formal legal-review process."

aria: I changed the example event shape to include retention_locked and updated the sample line in the SDK snippet: 

```
{"ts":"2025-03-12T14:02:00Z","tenant":"t_77","event":"auth.token.issue","retention_locked":true,"meta":{"route":"/v2/auth"}}
```

ben: Nice. Can we also add a tiny FAQ blurb: "Q: If I export data, does that change the tenant's retention policy? A: No, exports are snapshots and do not modify stored data or TTLs."

emma: I'll add the Python example to the SDK examples repo in a follow-up PR and include a changelog note.

aria: CI passed: docs-ci: build passed for PR #998 (:white_check_mark:). Ready for a final review.

charles: LGTM from security/legal after the wording tweaks. No blockers.

ben: Approving. I'll merge once the SDK PR lands so examples stay in sync.

emma: Opening SDK PR now -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/210 (tiny doc change + changelog).

aria: Thanks team 1 merging blocked on sdk PR, assigning self to merge when green. Target: tomorrow morning to coordinate with SDK release. :shipit:
